# mocaredd.dev

Development and test version of openforis/mocaredd

# Package index

## All functions

- [`fct_arithmetic_mean()`](https://gaelso.github.io/mocaredd.dev2/reference/fct_arithmetic_mean.md)
  : Calculate emissions based on arithmetic means
- [`fct_arithmetic_mean2()`](https://gaelso.github.io/mocaredd.dev2/reference/fct_arithmetic_mean2.md)
  : Calculate emissions and IPCC Tier 1 uncertainty from arithmetic
  means
- [`fct_calc_res()`](https://gaelso.github.io/mocaredd.dev2/reference/fct_calc_res.md)
  : Calculate median and confidence interval based on Monte Carlo
  Simulations
- [`fct_check_data2()`](https://gaelso.github.io/mocaredd.dev2/reference/fct_check_data2.md)
  : Check that the app's input data meet the template criteria.
- [`fct_checkinput()`](https://gaelso.github.io/mocaredd.dev2/reference/fct_checkinput.md)
  : Check and load the mocaredd input XLSX file
- [`fct_combine_mcs_E()`](https://gaelso.github.io/mocaredd.dev2/reference/fct_combine_mcs_E.md)
  : Generate and propagate Monte Carlo Simulations based on a template
  input file.
- [`fct_combine_mcs_ER()`](https://gaelso.github.io/mocaredd.dev2/reference/fct_combine_mcs_ER.md)
  : Combine MCS of emissions from Reference and monitoring period into
  emission reductions
- [`fct_combine_mcs_P()`](https://gaelso.github.io/mocaredd.dev2/reference/fct_combine_mcs_P.md)
  : Combine MCS of emissions to a defined time period
- [`fct_forestplot()`](https://gaelso.github.io/mocaredd.dev2/reference/fct_forestplot.md)
  : Make a forest plot to show Monte Carlo simulation results
- [`fct_histogram()`](https://gaelso.github.io/mocaredd.dev2/reference/fct_histogram.md)
  : Generate histogram to show the simulations at any stage.
- [`fct_make_formula()`](https://gaelso.github.io/mocaredd.dev2/reference/fct_make_formula.md)
  : Check that the app's the input data has matching land uses and
  correct carbon pools and associated factors.
- [`fct_make_mcs()`](https://gaelso.github.io/mocaredd.dev2/reference/fct_make_mcs.md)
  : Generate Monte Carlo Simulations for a given PDF
- [`fct_round()`](https://gaelso.github.io/mocaredd.dev2/reference/fct_round.md)
  : Reproduce round function from MS Excel
- [`fct_sensitivity2()`](https://gaelso.github.io/mocaredd.dev2/reference/fct_sensitivity2.md)
  : Sensitivity analysis of REDD+ emissions and emission reductions
- [`shiny_run_mocaredd_dev2()`](https://gaelso.github.io/mocaredd.dev2/reference/shiny_run_mocaredd_dev2.md)
  : Run Monte Carlo for REDD+ uncertainty's shiny app
